**Coaching note:**

Black's king is trapped on the back rank with limited escape squares. By checking with Qh6+, you force the king to g8—the only legal move. Then Rg5+ (a rook check from the side) forces it further into the corner to h8. The king has no escape: h7 is blocked by its own pawn, g8 is controlled by your rook. Finally, Qg7 is mate because the queen is protected by your rook on g5. **Lesson:** When the enemy king is cornered, look for forcing moves that drive it further into the trap rather than trying to mate immediately.
